# fixture data, never executed: a bound written as the n form; one W, bounded=no (a presence or emptiness test is not a comparison with the walk)
[ -n "${SOLEUR_TEST_SUITE_PID:-}" ] || exit 0
p=$1; top=""
while [ -r "/proc/$p/cmdline" ]; do
  top=$p; p=$(awk '{print $4}' "/proc/$p/stat")
done
[ -n "$top" ] && kill -TERM "$top"
